fullContent:
Chopchinyadi Churna 
 Reference – Yogaratnakara. 
 Introduction 
 Chopchinyadi churna is a polyherbal ayurvedic formulation. This medicine is known for alternative, diaphoretic, sedative and stimulant properties. This is helpful to treat problems related to skin and reproductive system. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Sugar 
 Triphala churna (Amla, Harad and Baheda) 
 Ginger (Zingiber officinalis) 
 Kokilaksha (Asteracantha longifolia) 
 Vidanga (Embelia ribes) 
 Chopchini (Smilax china) 
 Black pepper (Piper nigrum) 
 Pippalimoola (Piper longum) 
 Twak (Cinnamomum zeylanicum) 
 Clove (Syzigium aromaticum) 
 Akarakarabha (Anacyclus pyrethrum) 
 
 Method of preparation 
 Took all the herbs in the quantity of 10 grams. 
 Grinded all the herbs to make its powder form and mix well to get Chopchinyadi churna. 
 Dose 
 Two to three grams with warm milk or water, one or two times a day, after or before meals. 
 Indications 
 
 Gout 
 Cough 
 Seminal weakness 
 Pain and inflammation due to insect bites 
 Rheumatoid arthritis 
 
 Contraindications 
 Should take under medical supervision if suffer from diabetes. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
